# BTC Observer

> BTC Observer is a live Bitcoin market-intelligence dashboard: spot BTC/USDT price, 2-week spot Bitcoin ETF flows, 16+ technical indicators, a 24-hour probabilistic forecast and a compact long/short signal.

## What it includes

- Live BTC/USDT price, 24h change, high, low, volume and trades
- 2-week spot Bitcoin ETF net flows from farside, with IBIT/FBTC breakdown
- Technical indicators: EMA 20/50/200, RSI 14, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, Stochastic, ADX/DI, OBV, VWAP, CCI, Williams %R, MFI, ROC, Ichimoku, Fibonacci, Pivot Points
- 24-hour probabilistic GBM forecast with p10/p90 range
- Long/Short composite signal combining technicals and ETF flows
- One-page cosmic dark UI with a circular long/short gauge

## Data sources

- Market data: MEXC (Binance-compatible) with Binance fallback
- ETF flows: farside.co.uk, embedded 2-week dataset
- Forecast: probabilistic model; not financial advice

## API

- GET /api/market
- GET /api/etf
- GET /api/klines?interval=1h&limit=500
- GET /api/ticker

Not financial advice. Forecasts are probabilistic and can be wrong.
